itens.trecho: Sem mérito nem glória. Esta prequela de "O Exorcista" procura seguir o primeiro confronto entre o jovem Padre Merrin e Pazuzu, o que vai contrariar as cenas de abertura do primeiro filme desta franquia.

"Sometimes I think the best view of God is from Hell." This stopped being art and is more of a Hollywood prequel for the numbers. There is a good twist that you see coming and while it was cool to see, it still is not a great movie.
